en.title: CorsixTH Update Boosts Game Accessibility; Disability Advocacy Gains Worldwide
en.summary: The CorsixTH 0.70 release introduces UI scaling and accessibility improvements, enhancing gameplay for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Japanese lawmaker Eiko Kimura pushes for barrier-free reforms, and AbleVu partners with Pal Experiences to centralize family accessibility resources. Additionally, bus station accessibility upgrades are completed and early hearing treatment research highlights communication access.

highlights.title: Theme Hospital game engine CorsixTH 0.70 released with UI scaling, accessibility improvements and more
Japanese lawmaker with severe disability advocates for barrier-free reforms
AbleVu Partners with Pal Experiences to Bring Family Accessibility Resources into One Place
Work to make bus station more accessible completed
Early Treatment for Communication Accessibility Enables People to Hear the World's Beauty

zh-TW.title: CorsixTH 更新提升遊戲無障礙；殘障倡議與社會進步同步
zh-TW.summary: CorsixTH 0.70 版加入 UI 縮放及無障礙功能，提升殘障玩家的遊戲體驗。同時，日本議員木村英子推動無障礙改革，AbleVu 與 Pal Experiences 合作整合家庭無障礙資源。此外，佳里彩虹橋無障礙改造引發爭議，及早治療聽力障礙研究強調溝通無障礙的重要性。

highlights.title: Theme Hospital 遊戲引擎 CorsixTH 0.70 發布，包含 UI 縮放與無障礙改進
AbleVu 與 Pal Experiences 合作將家庭無障礙資源整合於一處
佳里人的回憶要沒了！「彩虹橋」無障礙改造 掀兩派論戰
聽見世界的美好 及早治療溝通無障礙
